Level 4 equipment Blade of Wisdom: The chance of applying break effects is reduced from 15% to 12%

notes.title: New feature update on December 9th
notes.content:
This update adds kungfus effect combinations, equipment, and difficulty levels 6 and 7.

Combination of kungfus effects:
Sancai: 50% chance of combo. Combo: Attack 2 times
Flying Dragon: Causes 30% damage to surrounding enemies after attacking
YinAndYang: 12% probability of causing the enemy to enter a state of chaos, lasting 2 seconds. Chaos state: attacking yourself
Four-Image: 15% chance to stun the enemy for 2 seconds
Seven sects: 25% chance of tapping the enemy (next attack will cause no damage)
Illusions: There is a 15% chance of creating an illusion when attacking. It inherits 50% of the attack and 25% of the health of the original body. It cannot restore blood. Up to 3 illusions can exist at the same time.
Invincible: Offset 1 fatal damage and restore 100% HP
Ice and Fire: 15% chance to freeze the enemy for 2 seconds (unable to move, but +30% damage reduction), 30% chance to burn the enemy for 2 seconds (healing is converted into double damage)
Tianshan Stargazing: Status Resistance +30%
Accumulation: After receiving 3 damage, attack the surrounding enemies once.

The kungfus required for activation can be viewed in the "Preset kungfus" grouped by effect.

Equipment: A total of 35 new pieces of equipment have been added, divided into levels 1-5, with 7 pieces per level. After waves 4, 14, 24, 34, and 44, you can choose a piece of level 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 equipment respectively. Each time, 5 pieces of equipment will be randomly selected from 7 pieces.

level1 items
Shovel: +10 basic life, 10% chance of getting 1 copper coin after killing an enemy
Seed: +15 base life, +5 health recovery per second
Gloves: +5 base attack, +(2×number of enemies) attack speed
Medal: When the blood volume is >50%, +10 basic attack; when the blood volume is <=50%, +5% damage reduction
Broom: +5 basic attack, +2% damage reduction, +3% attack speed
Spear: +5% attack speed, 15% chance to reduce the enemy's attack speed by 15%, lasting 2 seconds
Ring: +5 base health, +15 health recovery per second after being attacked, lasting 2 seconds

Level2 items
Dragon Scale Shield: +4% damage reduction, +10 basic HP. After hitting the enemy, it will enter a burning state and receive 20% of the player's attack damage every second.
Light Bow: +10% attack speed, 100% probability of reducing the enemy's attack speed by 10%
Pearl of Greed: -20 base attack, +2 copper coins at the end of each wave
Heavy Rain Pear Blossom Needle: +10 basic attack, causing 15% damage to surrounding enemies after hitting
Destruction Spirit Ball: Enemy damage reduction -10% after hit
Blood-drinking sword: blood-sucking +5%, enemy recovery effect after hit -15%
Magic Eye: -30% final HP, +20% final attack, +20% attack speed

Level3 items
Ax of Justice: Attack speed +20%, damage reduction +30% when in dizziness or chaos state
Flame Cloak: Damage reduction +10%, causing 20% attack damage to all enemies every second
Ritual Robe: Damage increased by +10%, enemy status resistance -10%
Titan's residual iron: +10% damage reduction, +20% status resistance
Hou Yi's Quiver: Ignore the enemy and reduce damage by 75%
Elf Coat: Attack speed +25%, dodge +10%
Unyielding Shell: +10% final HP, 25% chance to counterattack when hit, causing 50% × (attack + maximum HP) damage

Level4 equipment
Saint's Relic: Damage increased by +20%, enemy status resistance -15%
Blade of Wisdom: Attack speed +30%, 15% probability of causing damage to the enemy (cannot apply negative effects), lasts 2 seconds
Hammer of Catastrophe: +15% final HP, +15% final attack, causing 50% × (attack + maximum HP) damage to all enemies every second
Invisibility Cloak: +10% dodge, +10% damage reduction, 10% chance of immunity to negative status
Simple short hat: +10% final HP, +20% status resistance, 50% chance of reducing duration by 20% when receiving negative status
Dragon-slaying sword: +40% final attack, 25% chance of reducing the enemy's attack speed by 100% when attacking.
Dragon scale armor: +15% damage reduction, 15% chance of reflecting all damage when receiving damage

Level5 equipment
Hammer of the God of Wealth: Attack speed +100%, +15 copper coins at the end of each wave
Sword of Annihilation: Final attack +100%, enemy damage reduction -20% after hit
Ring of the Giant: Final HP +100%, causing (20% × attack + 100% × maximum HP) damage to all enemies every second
Shadow Cloak: +30% final HP, +30% final attack, 20% chance of being immune to damage and negative status when attacked
Book of Death: +25% final HP, +15% damage reduction, summons 2 clones at the beginning of the battle, inherits 20% of the original attack, 25% of HP, and cannot recover HP.
Heart of the Dragon: final HP +120%, maximum HP block +2%, recovery rate +20%
Heart of Heaven and Earth: +20% final HP, +20% final attack, +10% damage reduction, enemy recovery effect after attack -50%, damage reduction -10%

Gameplay tweaks:
Slightly increased the probability of obtaining blue martial arts in the early stage
Balanced the damage rate of move stacks

notes.title: Updated on November 14th
notes.content:
In order to improve players' experience in the early stages of the game, some game mechanics have been updated and balanced this time.

Gameplay tweaks:
1. After each wave, you can choose martial arts multiple times. The first time is free, the second time consumes 1 copper coin, and so on. After selecting, click Next to continue the game.
2. The number of martial arts required to upgrade to level 3 is reduced from 4 to 3, and the corresponding improved attributes are reduced by 25%.
3. Moves can now be triggered simultaneously, and the damage of all corresponding moves is reduced by 40%.
4. The initial attributes and characteristics of the scholar have been adjusted and redone. The specific values ​​can be viewed in the game.

UI optimization:
1. Optimized the display of the preset page. Players can now see the attribute values activated by the preset.

bug fixes:
Fixed the problem of abnormal attributes after 50 waves in endless mode
